source.title: Veeam KB4771: Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2.4165 Patch

records.title: A vulnerability in the Mount service allows an authenticated domain user to execute code remotely on backup infrastructure hosts.
conditions: This issue affects domain-joined Veeam Backup & Replication v12 backup infrastructure servers. Veeam states that non-domain-joined hosts and the Veeam Software Appliance are not affected.
Veeam states that unsupported product versions are not tested but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.

source.title: Veeam KB4743: Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2

records.title: A vulnerability allows an authenticated domain user to execute code remotely on the backup server.
conditions: This issue affects domain-joined backup servers.
Veeam states that unsupported product versions are not tested but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.

records.title: An authenticated Backup Operator can modify backup jobs in a way that executes arbitrary code.
conditions: Veeam states that unsupported product versions are not tested but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.

records.title: A vulnerability allows an authenticated domain user to execute code remotely on the backup server.
conditions: This issue affects domain-joined backup servers. KB4724 also offers a build-specific hotfix for 12.3.0.310; verify its file hashes if using that remediation.
Veeam states that unsupported product versions are not tested but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.

advisories.remediation: Install Veeam Backup & Replication 12.0.0.1420 P20230223 or 11.0.1.1261 P20230227. Earlier versions must first be upgraded to a supported version.

records.title: An unauthenticated user inside the backup infrastructure network perimeter can obtain encrypted credentials from the configuration database.
conditions: The vulnerable Veeam Backup Service listens on TCP 9401 by default. Patch-level verification is required because the fixed 11a and 12 builds retain their base build numbers.

advisories.remediation: Install Veeam Backup & Replication 11.0.1.1261 P20220302 or 10.0.1.4854 P20220304. Veeam Backup & Replication 9.5 must be upgraded to a supported version.

records.title: A domain user can execute malicious code remotely through the Microsoft SCVMM integration component.
conditions: The default installation is not affected; an SCVMM server must be registered. Patch-level verification is required because the fixed 10a and 11a builds retain their base build numbers.

advisories.remediation: Install Veeam Backup & Replication 11.0.1.1261 P20220302 or 10.0.1.4854 P20220304. Veeam Backup & Replication 9.5 must be upgraded to a supported version. Stopping and disabling the Veeam Distribution Service is only a temporary mitigation.
conditions: The vulnerable Veeam Distribution Service listens on TCP 9380 by default. Patch-level verification is required because the fixed 10a and 11a builds retain their base build numbers.

records.title: An unauthenticated attacker can execute malicious code remotely through internal Veeam Distribution Service API functions.
An unauthenticated attacker can execute malicious code remotely through internal Veeam Distribution Service API functions.

source.title: Veeam KB2662: Zip Slip Vulnerability

advisories.remediation: Apply the KB2662 hotfix for Veeam Backup & Replication 8 Update 3, 9.0 Update 2, 9.5 Update 2, or 9.5 Update 3. The fix is included in 9.5 Update 3a.

records.title: The DotNetZip Zip Slip vulnerability permits arbitrary file overwrite through path-traversal filenames during guest file system indexing.
conditions: Veeam documents guest file system indexing as the only known attack path. Veeam does not publish a CVSS score in KB2662.

source.title: Veeam KB2180: Veeam Backup & Replication Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability

records.title: A low-privileged local Windows user can read Veeam Backup logs and recover the password used to run privileged Veeam components.
conditions: KB2180 publishes the malformed identifier CVE20155742; it is canonicalized to CVE-2015-5742. Veeam does not publish a CVSS score in the article. Updating to Veeam Backup & Replication 9.x is also a documented solution.

source.title: Veeam KB3103: List of Security Fixes and Improvements in Veeam Backup & Replication

advisories.remediation: Install Veeam Backup & Replication 11.0.0.837 P20210507 or 10.0.1.4854 P20210609, or a later release containing those fixes.

records.title: A vulnerability in Microsoft .NET remoting deserialization logic was fixed.
conditions: KB3103 is the only Veeam advisory source for this catalog finding and does not publish a CVSS score or a separate affected-build statement. Verify the installed patch date because the fixed builds retain their base build numbers.

source.title: Veeam KB4879: Veeam Software Appliance and Veeam Infrastructure Appliance Updater Component Vulnerability
Veeam KB4491: Security Issue in Microsoft Azure Plug-In for Veeam Backup & Replication

advisories.remediation: Upgrade Microsoft Azure Plug-In for Veeam Backup & Replication from 12.1.5.99 to 12.1.5.106, then rotate the appliance administrator password in Veeam Backup for Microsoft Azure and Veeam Backup & Replication.

records.title: The Microsoft Azure plug-in can expose a Veeam Backup for Microsoft Azure appliance administrator password in an updater log.
conditions: This issue applies when an Azure appliance was upgraded to version 5a using Microsoft Azure Plug-In 12.1.5.99. KB4491 does not assign a CVE or publish a CVSS score.

source.title: Veeam KB4682: Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager Vulnerability (CVE-2024-40715)

advisories.remediation: Upgrade Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager 12.1.2.172 or earlier to 12.2.0.334 using the repackaged ISO, or apply the KB4682 hotfix to an existing 12.2.0.334 deployment.

records.title: An attacker performing a man-in-the-middle attack can bypass Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager authentication.
conditions: Veeam documents this issue for the optional Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager component. Verify that Enterprise Manager is deployed; this does not downgrade the upgrade reason.
The 12.2.0.334 hotfix does not establish a distinct product build in the catalog; verify hotfix deployment.

advisories.remediation: Apply the KB4508 hotfix matching the embedded Veeam ONE build. Veeam Recovery Orchestrator 6 GA must first be updated to VRO 6 P20230419 so its embedded Veeam ONE build is 12.0.1.2591.
conditions: Veeam Recovery Orchestrator embeds Veeam ONE. VRO 7 is not affected because it uses Veeam ONE 12.1. Verify the embedded Veeam ONE build and hotfix files.

records.title: The embedded Veeam ONE component can disclose SQL connection information to an unauthenticated user, potentially leading to code execution on its configuration database server.
An unprivileged embedded Veeam ONE Web Client user can acquire the NTLM hash of the Veeam ONE Reporting Service account.
An embedded Veeam ONE Power User can use cross-site scripting to obtain an administrator access token.
An embedded Veeam ONE Read-Only User can view the Dashboard Schedule.

source.title: Veeam KB4693: Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3

conditions: Veeam states that unsupported product versions are not tested but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.

records.title: An authenticated user with a role assigned on the backup server can execute a pre-job or post-job script as LocalSystem.
An authenticated user with a role assigned on the backup server can access all saved credentials in a human-readable format.
An authenticated user with a role assigned on the backup server can remotely upload files to connected ESXi hosts with elevated privileges.
An authenticated user with a role assigned on the backup server can control and modify the configuration of connected virtual infrastructure hosts.
An authenticated user with a role assigned on the backup server can exploit insecure deserialization to delete files with service-account privileges.
An authenticated user with a role assigned on the backup server can access privileged methods and control critical services.
An authenticated user with certain operator roles can expose saved credentials through the remote management interface.
An authenticated user with an assigned role can exploit insufficient credential-handling permissions and potentially leak saved-credential NTLM hashes.

source.title: Veeam KB4902: Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1

advisories.remediation: Upgrade to Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.0.411 or 13.0.3.63, or a later release in the selected version branch. After upgrading, change the passwords associated with credentials used for Application-Aware Processing. The fix prevents future password logging but does not remove existing log files.

records.title: Guest OS credentials used for application-aware processing can be recorded in cleartext in logs on the guest machine.
conditions: Veeam states that Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.2.29 and all earlier version 13 builds are affected; older 12.x versions are not affected.
Verify access controls and retention for guest-machine logs that may contain recorded credentials; this does not remove the need to upgrade an affected build.

records.title: An authenticated Veeam Cloud Connect tenant can read arbitrary files on the service provider host.
records.remediation: Upgrade the selected branch to Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.0.411, 13.0.3.63, or 12.3.2.4934, or a later release containing the fix.
conditions: Veeam documents this issue for Windows-based Veeam Backup & Replication acting as a Cloud Connect service provider host; exploitation requires an authenticated tenant.
Veeam states that unsupported product versions are not tested but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.
